description: Fetch 1-15 years of historical financial statements for one exact Bullrun ticker. Returns annual and/or quarterly rows grouped into income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, per-share metrics, margins, source currency, and annual growth/CAGR consistency checks. Use this when evaluating multi-year revenue/net-income growth, margin trajectories, leverage, cash flow quality, or whether a stock passed a rule such as 10% revenue and net-income growth every year.

includeEmptyRows.description: Include sparse rows that have no major income statement, balance sheet, cash-flow, or EPS values.

periodType.description: Return annual rows, quarterly rows, or both. Annual rows use fiscalQuarter=0.

ticker.description: The Bullrun ticker. Bullrun tickers: US and most European listings use the plain local symbol (AAPL, BMW, NESN, ABBN); most Asian and Indian listings keep their exchange suffix (Tokyo 6324.T, Hong Kong 0700.HK, Shanghai 600519.SS, Shenzhen 000001.SZ, Taiwan 2330.TW, Korea 000100.KS, Singapore D05.SI, India RELIANCE.NS), but some Japanese and Korean large caps are plain codes (Toyota 7203, Samsung 005930). Either form is resolved automatically when exactly one listing matches; use search_stocks to find a ticker by company name or ISIN.

years.description: How many fiscal years of history to return, counting backward from the latest fiscal year available.

name: get_financial_history
title: Get financial history
